literal: Those who dig (it) / bears / earth / like / oneself / those who insult / bearing / foremost.
translation: Just as the earth bears those who dig into it, bearing with those who insult oneself is the foremost virtue.
modern: தன்னைத் தோண்டுபவர்களையும் தாங்குகின்ற பூமியைப் போல, தன்னை அவமதிப்பவர்களையும் பொறுத்துக்கொள்வதே மிகச் சிறந்த பண்பாகும்.
explanation: This couplet uses a powerful natural simile to define the highest form of forbearance. The earth does not punish those who dig into it; instead, it continues to support them. In the same way, the greatest virtue is to patiently endure and forgive those who insult or harm us. The word 'தலை' literally means 'head', but is used metaphorically here to mean the foremost or highest quality.
